name: wiki
description: Vue.js 模板驱动 Wiki 系统：展示系统与编辑系统共用一份内容数据与模板 Schema

scripts.check: node scripts/node-guard.mjs && node scripts/build-index.ts && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node scripts/node-guard.mjs && node --test shared/richtext/parse.test.ts editor/src/state/tree.test.ts editor/src/state/history.test.ts editor/src/state/editor.test.ts
scripts.build:dist: npm run build:public && npm run build:editor && node scripts/assemble-dist.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:editor
